question: Should openclaw/crabbox own and support this Zed registry extension as a first-party integration?
rationale: The patch establishes a new published integration and ongoing compatibility surface; repository history and automated checks cannot determine whether maintainers intend to own that product commitment.

options.title: Sponsor first-party integration
options.body: Approve repository ownership after the Windows task behavior is addressed and real Zed proof is supplied.

options.title: Approve Unix-only scope
options.body: Explicitly accept a macOS/Linux-only interactive task surface and require prominent platform limitations in registry-facing documentation.

options.title: Keep it external
options.body: Publish and maintain the Zed package outside this repository while continuing to use Crabbox's existing CLI contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor first-party integration
recommendation.body: Approve repository ownership after the Windows task behavior is addressed and real Zed proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The contributor requested the ownership decision from this person, whose recent work spans the repository's CLI and integration surfaces.
